title: Escalators and moving walks.
officialText:
Escalators and moving walks shall be constructed of approved noncombustible and fire-
retardant materials. This requirement shall not apply to electrical equipment, wiring, wheels, handrails and the use of 1/28 -inch
(0.9 mm) wood veneers on balustrades backed up with noncombustible materials.
